name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a silver-gold developer advancing its flagship Diablillos project in the Puna region of Salta Province, Argentina. The project completed a Definitive Feasibility Study in June 2026 and hosts Proven and Probable Mineral Reserves of 77.9 Mt grading 146 g/t silver equivalent, containing 184 Moz of silver and 1.8 Moz of gold. The company is in the development stage with first production targeted for 2029.
